venture: Example: flat-fee event ticketing for independent organizers

customers.label: organizers
customers.source: UNVERIFIED: 4 organizers in month 1 from the walk-in plan in 01-wedge.md; 10%/mo growth and a 150/mo ceiling on what one founder can onboard; 6% monthly churn because small organizers stop running events; CAC is founder sales time at a loaded hourly rate plus a launch promo. Replace all four with 60 days of real data

revenue_lines.name: Ticket fee
revenue_lines.source: Price: published organizer pricing, flat $0.99 per paid ticket. Volume UNVERIFIED: ~90 paid tickets/organizer/month (one or two smaller events); attach 60% because many organizers run free events

revenue_lines.name: Messaging credits
revenue_lines.source: Blended 5c email / 8c SMS from published pricing. Sold on the web dashboard only, so no store commission (see traps.csv T01/T02). Usage UNVERIFIED

revenue_lines.name: Featured placement
revenue_lines.source: UNVERIFIED: ~$10/day featured slot x ~4 days a month; 10% of organizers buy. Web-only purchase. Processing at the card rate on the processor's pricing page
